style: A warm, friendly young Indian woman in her late twenties, a teacher talking to another teacher, in natural conversational English with a light, clear Indian accent. Relaxed, like talking to a friend, never a newsreader or an advert. Smooth flow with short natural breaths at commas and full stops.

lines.text: Almost eleven at night... class test tomorrow, and the paper isn’t even typed.
lines.style: Late at night, a little tired and worried, quieter, a real teacher's small sigh of stress.

lines.text: No problem... open Testoza, and take just one photo.
lines.style: Reassuring, a small smile, the mood lifts; quick and easy.

lines.text: The AI reads every question from the photo... with the options and the answer key.
Ten questions... ready in just seventeen seconds!
lines.style: The number lands, pleased and a little amazed.

lines.text: Make the test live, and just send your students a six-digit code.
Next morning, students type the code... and the test begins.
lines.style: Fresh morning feel, light and calm.

lines.text: Late-night stress, gone with one photo. Testoza.com, completely free.
lines.style: Warm relieved payoff, then say the web address slowly and clearly: testoza dot com.
